brief: Keeps named events with timestamps in the engine and answers questions about them, such as how many fall in a range.
detail: The store lives in the engine and is shared by every stzEngineTimeline object of the process, so call Clear() first when you want a fresh one. Positions are counted from 0, in the order the events were added. Timestamps are plain numbers in the unit you choose. Duration() answers 0 today. It is not the stzTimeLine class of the datetime module.
receiver:
o1 = new stzEngineTimeline()
o1.Clear()
o1.AddEvent("start", 100)
o1.AddEvent("build", 200)
